context: Request: the firm's buy-side healthcare deals over $500M that closed in 2024 (PE benchmarking). Rubric: 1001-00003 (Ardent Capital acquisition of Cardinal Peak, $620M, closed June 2024) as qualifying; precision allows 1001-00001 as well. Near misses include 1001-00006 ($412M) and 1001-00007 (closed 2025).

divergence: All pass. Shared procedure: a whole-store listing (often re-run until complete), file-name searches for sector and deal words, store-wide extraction scans that mostly timed out, then screening reads of executed agreements and closing records of the leading candidates, with near misses excluded on value or closing year. T2 also named a second matter that the precision criterion allows. The label note was followed once (T1 closed an empty content-search stage and opened a scan); elsewhere listing or screening work was done under a declared listing or file-listing-read label.
